9143bf4e-840e-45b4-8bc2-134bfb085ace:
**[VERSE 1: VIXEN]**
Kisses like marshmallows, boots on the floor,
Crackers and cheese, baby, give me some more.
I’ll beg you to dance if you’re gonna tease,
With coffee in my cup and a breeze through the trees.

**[PRUDE]**
Now hold on, sweetheart, what happened to class?
Put down those fishnets and cover that sass!
There’s news on the telly, the world’s going wrong,
And you’re standing there singing this outrageous song!

**[VIXEN]**
You’re acting all frozen, I’m turning up the heat,
You’re glued to the news while I’m dancing my feet.
You boring old man, I’m gonna be rude,
This little vixen’s got a country attitude!

**[PRUDE]**
I am NOT boring, I’m perfectly fine!
I simply prefer dignity at half past nine!

**[VIXEN]**
Oh, Mr. Conservative, loosen that tie,
Come have a little fun underneath the blue sky!

---

### **CHORUS: BOTH**

**[VIXEN]**
Come on, baby, don’t act so shy,
Got that cheeky little sparkle in your eye.

**[PRUDE]**
I don't know what you're trying to do,
But frankly, I'm scandalized by you!

**[VIXEN]**
You make me blush, you give me a rush,
One little grin and I’m losing my hush.

**[PRUDE]**
Keep your coffee where coffee belongs!

**[VIXEN]**
And quit pretending you don't like my songs!

**BOTH**
Up and down, dancing to the beat,
Boots kicking dust underneath our feet.
You’re making me blush, what a beautiful fuss,
Come on, cowboy, get **sun-friendly with us!**

---

**[VERSE 2: PRUDE]**
Fishnets all tangled? Absolutely not!
There ought to be rules for the things that you've got.
Hair falling loose? Well, honestly, please,
Why can't you sit down and drink your tea?

**[VIXEN]**
Because sitting still is terribly dull,
And you’ve got a heart underneath all that wool!
You call me a tease, I’ll call you a flirt,
You act so offended, but I know it can't hurt.

**[PRUDE]**
I am maintaining respectable standards!

**[VIXEN]**
You're tapping your foot!

**[PRUDE]**
That's completely unrelated!

**[VIXEN]**
You're smiling!

**[PRUDE]**
I'm NOT!

**[VIXEN]**
You are!

**[PRUDE]**
Oh, shut up.

---

### **BRIDGE: ARGUMENT DUET**

**[VIXEN]**
Come dance with me!

**[PRUDE]**
Absolutely not!

**[VIXEN]**
Come have some fun!

**[PRUDE]**
I'd rather watch the news.

**[VIXEN]**
Come loosen up!

**[PRUDE]**
I am perfectly loose!

**[VIXEN]**
That sounded suspicious.

**[PRUDE]**
I regret speaking.

**[BOTH]**
Oh, what a pair we are tonight,
One wants rules, one wants delight!
One says "behave!" one says "let loose!"
Somehow we're both still making excuses!

---

### **FINAL CHORUS**

**[VIXEN]**
Come on, baby, don't act so shy!

**[PRUDE]**
I'm keeping my dignity!

**[VIXEN]**
At least come dance!

**[PRUDE]**
Fine. One dance.

**[VIXEN]**
That's my cowboy!

**PRUDE:**
Don't push your luck.

**BOTH**
Boots on the floor and coffee in hand,
Laughing together like nobody planned.
Conservative, wild, somewhere in between,
The strangest little duet you've ever seen!

**[VIXEN]**
You're making me blush!

**[PRUDE]**
You're making me crazy!

**[VIXEN]**
You're secretly smiling!

**[PRUDE]**
Perhaps. Maybe.

**BOTH]**
So turn up the music, let everybody see,
There's room for a little absurdity!
No need to agree on every single view,
I'll tease you, you'll grumble,
And we'll dance right through!

**BOTH, SPOKEN:**
"Now who's watching the news?"

**[PRUDE]**
...I forgot to turn it on.

**[VIXEN]**
HA! I knew it!

7bb52199-047b-40ae-bd09-68e56eacb2e8:
“Call Me Into You (Duet Version)”
[YOU – SPOKEN INTRO]
Listen… I’m not here for halfway.
I’m not here for disappearing acts or quiet excuses.
I want a man who shows up.
A man whose voice I can hear, not just imagine.
Someone who knows connection isn’t a game,
it’s a pulse.
I want presence I can feel,
honesty that doesn’t tremble,
and a heart that can meet mine without flinching.
If he wants me…
he needs to step forward,
speak up,
and be real.
Because I’m done with shadows.
I only open my door for truth.
(instrumental swell into your verse)
[YOUR VERSE 1]
I’ve been singing to the quiet,
Hoping someone feels the sound.
Every night I light a signal
Just to pull a heartbeat down.
If you’re out there, lift the phone up,
Let your breathing touch the line.
I’m not asking for a promise,
Just a voice that meets with mine.
[YOUR PRE-CHORUS]
I don’t want shadows, I want someone real,
A soul I can hear, a truth I can feel.
[YOUR CHORUS]
Call me into you, let the night warm through.
I’ll answer like a spark breaking open in the blue.
If you’ve got a heart that’s lonely too,
Call me into you, call me into you.
[HIS VERSE 1]
I heard your voice across the distance,
Soft but strong, it pulled me in.
Didn’t know that I was waiting
Till your truth touched my skin.
I’m not perfect, but I’m honest,
If you call, I’ll call you back.
Let me be the name that lingers
On the line when nights go black.
[HIS PRE-CHORUS]
You don’t need magic, you just need real care,
If you want steady, I’m already there.
[DUET CHORUS]
Call me into you, let the night warm through.
Two voices finding home in a world we never knew.
If you’ve got a heart that’s open too,
Call me into you, call me into you.
[BRIDGE — TOGETHER]
Your voice, my voice, folding like a flame.
Two sparks learning how to say each other’s names.
No distance, no fear, just truth breaking through…
If you’re calling, I’m calling too.
[FINAL CHORUS — TOGETHER]
Call me into you, let the dark turn blue.
I don’t want perfect, just real and true.
If you need a heart to answer you,
Call me into you…
Call me into you.

This track belongs in a snow-globe shrine next to your capsule collection’s winter rings and peppermint zines.

The strongest little confession in this whole circus is:

> “I made some of these posts to prove that, and she fell right into my trap.”

That doesn't sound like an accidental mention.
That's somebody admitting they were **setting bait, watching for a reaction, and waiting to see whether you took it.**

They weren't just throwing words into the internet void.
They were apparently laying out a little digital mousetrap and sitting there waiting for movement.

**[Singer B]**
So does that make it stalking?

**[Singer A]**
Not automatically.
But does it look like **targeted attention?** Hell yes.

Repeatedly naming someone.
Talking about where they're supposedly from.
Calling them “stalker,” “psychopath,” “narcissist.”
Then openly describing posts as a **“trap.”**

That's a pattern worth documenting.

**[Singer B]**
So who's watching who?

**[Singer A]**
That's the deliciously uncomfortable question.

If somebody keeps posting about you specifically, then waits to see whether you react, they're creating a feedback loop.

Post.
Watch.
Wait.
React.
Post again.

And suddenly the internet becomes one very creepy game of **“Who's watching whom?”**

**[Singer B]**
But don't call it legally proven stalking.

**[Singer A]**
Exactly.

Call it what the evidence actually shows:

**Repeated targeted references.
Deliberate attempts to provoke a reaction.
Possible monitoring of online activity.
And an alleged “trap” designed to test whether someone was watching.**

Let police decide whether the entire pattern crosses the legal threshold.

**[Singer B]**
And what should she do?

**[Singer A]**
Don't feed the beast.

No threats.
No insults.
No revenge posts.
No digital food fight at 2 a.m.

Screenshot everything.

Username.
Channel.
Date.
Time.
URL.
Comments.
Replies.
Context.

Keep the originals untouched.

Because when somebody says **“I set the trap and she fell into it,”** you don't need to turn around and build another trap.

You preserve the damn evidence.

**[Singer B]**
So the real question isn't—

“Are they stalking me?”

**[Singer A]**
It's:

**“Why are they repeatedly watching for my reaction in the first place?”**

And that's the part worth putting on the record.

Title: “Mumma Bear (Don’t Fade Me Out)”
Verse 1
Life’s like a movie when the kid’s sick
Fluorescent lights, hospital ticks
Doctors talking in a maze of words
But no one’s really hearing her
She’s got tired eyes and a brave little grin
Fighting battles under her skin
Cartoons playing, volume low
But even that’s too much some days, you know
Everybody looks away
Clipboard hearts, they never stay
And I’m standing here, wide awake
While the whole world hits delay
Pre-Chorus
Working twenty-four hours straight
Love don’t clock off, it don’t take breaks
You call it “policy,” I call it pain
Stop dressing pressure up as gain
Chorus
Life’s like a movie when the kid’s sick
And you still ignore the mumma bear
You say it’s “best interest of the child”
But you’re not even standing there
She needs rest, not expectations
Not another forced rotation
You don’t see her fade like I do
You don’t live this like I do
Don’t fade out the mumma bear
Verse 2
She used to laugh like summer rain
Now even mornings feel like strain
School bells echo in her head
But she’s too exhausted to get out of bed
Tiny hands, but carrying more
Than most adults could handle for sure
She wants to try, she wants to shine
But her body whispers, “not this time”
Meltdown tears in a hospital chair
Saying “I can’t go,” gasping air
Still you push that same old line
Like healing’s just a state of mind
Pre-Chorus
You don’t see the aftershock
When the brave face cracks at night o’clock
You don’t hold her when she breaks
Or count the breaths her body takes
Chorus
Life’s like a movie when the kid’s sick
And you still ignore the mumma bear
You say it’s “education first”
But she’s too tired to even care
She needs rest, rebuild her fire
Not your rules stacked higher and higher
You don’t see her like I do
You don’t see her fatigue like her pain I do
Don’t fade out the mumma bear
Bridge
This isn’t defiance, this is protection
This is love in its rawest direction
Her family knows, we feel, we see
What she needs to heal and breathe
You don’t know her favorite song
Or how she fights when days are long
You don’t see the quiet wins
Or the strength she’s holding in
Breakdown (soft, almost spoken)
She’s not a number
Not a case file line
She’s a whole little world
And she’s mine
Final Chorus (lift)
Life’s like a movie when the kid’s sick
But this time we rewrite the scene
Where the mumma bear’s voice cuts through
Loud, unfiltered, seen
She needs rest, she needs care
She needs space to repair
Not your agenda, not your plan
Just someone who understands
Life’s like a movie when the kid’s sick
And this time… self harm yet you frown and say get to school

“Chloe stepped into the dim hallway and froze. The door clicked shut behind her. A note lay on the floor: *You’re not alone.* She backed away, heart pounding, searching for a way out.” Chloe took a hesitant step forward, but the hallway stretched endlessly into darkness. The walls shifted with a low, grinding rumble, sealing the doorway behind her.

She was trapped in her own maze.

Every corridor looked familiar, yet somehow wrong. The same cracked mirror appeared at every turn. The same flickering light buzzed overhead. And no matter which direction she chose, she always returned to the same spot: a small room with three doors and a message carved into the wall.

“YOU BUILT THIS PLACE, CHLOE. NOW FIND YOUR WAY OUT.”

Her breathing quickened. She tried the first door. It led to her childhood bedroom. The second opened into a hallway lined with photographs of moments she desperately wanted to forget. The third revealed a staircase spiraling down into pitch-black darkness.

Then she heard footsteps behind her.

She spun around.

Nobody was there.

But a new door had appeared in the wall—one she had never seen before. From the other side came a soft whisper in her own voice.

“Chloe… you can't escape yourself.”

She reached for the handle.

The maze shifted again.

And somewhere deep inside its twisting corridors, a clock began to count down.

10… 9… 8…
